name: Ideology of the Chinese Communist Party
summary: The CCP's official ideology is Marxism-Leninism adapted to China, running through Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the Three Represents, the Scientific Outlook on Development and Xi Jinping Thought. Its own documents hold that the Party must lead the state and army, that China is a people's democratic dictatorship at the primary stage of socialism with dominant public ownership alongside a socialist market economy, that class struggle persists but is no longer the main contradiction, and that communism remains the ultimate goal. Foreign policy rests on sovereignty, non-interference and opposition to hegemonism, and the Party treats Taiwan as part of China that it will not promise to leave unreached by force.
scope: The current official line of the Party as set out in its constitution's General Program (2002 text), the 2022 report to the 20th National Congress, the 2021 resolution on the Party's history, and the state constitution as amended in 2018 under which the Party rules. Mao Zedong Thought and Deng Xiaoping Theory count as the Party presents them there. It excludes dissident Marxist, Maoist-revival and liberal reformist currents inside China, and the documents are silent on most social and moral questions, which stay null.

all-land-state-owned.rationale: The state constitution provides that rural land is owned by collectives, which contradicts the claim that all land is state owned.

armed-resistance-to-occupation.rationale: The history resolution presents the Party's people's war of resistance against Japanese occupation as a central achievement.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: The constitution empowers the National People's Congress to examine and approve the state budget.

central-planning.rationale: The 2021 history resolution presents the move from a highly centralized planned economy to a socialist market economy as an achievement, rejecting the planned model as the better one.

class-collaboration.rationale: The programme says class struggle is no longer the principal contradiction and calls for uniting all workers, farmers, intellectuals and patriotic forces in a broad patriotic united front.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: The programme and constitution state that class struggle will continue to exist within certain bounds for a long time, though no longer as the principal contradiction.

colonial-socialism-democratic-stage.rationale: The programme and the history resolution describe a new-democratic revolution against imperialism and feudalism that came first and then a transition from New Democracy to socialism in semi-colonial China.

conscription.rationale: The constitution makes military service in accordance with law an honorable duty of citizens.

decide-locally.rationale: The constitution guides the division of powers by giving local authorities initiative under the unified leadership of the central authorities.

defeat-communism.rationale: The Party's programme sets communism as its ultimate goal.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The constitution calls the people's democratic dictatorship, led by the working class, in essence the dictatorship of the proletariat, though it does not state the 'until classes disappear' condition.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: The constitution has the National People's Congress elect the President, so direct popular election is not the method.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: The 20th report commits to carbon peaking and neutrality, phased and planned rather than drastic.

elective-rulers.rationale: The constitution provides that the President is elected, by the National People's Congress.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The constitution says all citizens are equal before the law; the text is limited to citizens.

ethnic-nation.rationale: The constitution describes a unified multi-ethnic state in which all ethnicities are equal.

expand-nuclear.rationale: The 20th report says to develop nuclear power in an active, safe and orderly manner.

filial-duty.rationale: The constitution states that adult children have the duty to support and assist their parents.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: The 20th report says the Party will never promise to renounce the use of force over Taiwan and directs it at separatists and outside interference.

harm-principle.rationale: The constitution bars citizens from exercising freedoms in ways that infringe the interests of the state, society or the collective, a wider ground than harm to others.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Distribution according to work is stated as the dominant principle, with other modes of distribution alongside it, so income is meant mainly to reward work.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: The history resolution counts China's nuclear weapons among the achievements of its defense industry.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: The 20th report says the Party must not mechanically imitate others or indiscriminately absorb foreign ideas and follows a path suited to China's conditions.

legal-duty-to-work.rationale: The constitution declares work both a right and a duty of citizens, though it frames it as a matter of honour rather than prescribing penalties.

limit-growth.rationale: The programme makes development the Party's top priority and the criterion for judging its work, though it also pursues sustainable development and ecological conservation.

limit-population.rationale: The constitution says the state promotes family planning so that population growth fits development plans, while the 20th report sets a policy system to boost birth rates, so the sources point both ways.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: The programme calls for a socialist market economy kept and improved under Party leadership, the stated line that this statement describes.

minority-language-support.rationale: The constitution lets organs of ethnic autonomy protect and develop minority cultures and use minority languages in official work.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: The constitution and the Party programme provide regional autonomy where minorities live in concentrated communities.

multipolar-world.rationale: The history resolution says the Party promoted the development of a multipolar world.

national-mission.rationale: The 20th report warns against mechanically imitating others and the programme confines the Party to its own national path, with no mission to spread its government abroad.

national-rebirth.rationale: The history resolution frames the Party's mission as national rejuvenation after the humiliation that followed the Opium War.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The programme calls communism the highest ideal and ultimate goal and treats capitalism as something to resist, so it rejects the statement that neither is sound.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The constitution has the state develop the economy, education, health and culture, which a state limited to protecting people from violence would not.

no-transition-to-communism.rationale: The programme holds that communism can be realised only after a long, fully developed socialist stage and that China is in the primary stage of socialism, a stage that cannot be skipped.

one-party-rule.rationale: The constitution states that the defining feature of socialism with Chinese characteristics is the leadership of the Communist Party, and the Four Cardinal Principles require upholding it.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The constitution makes the National People's Congress the body that amends the Constitution, enacts basic laws and elects the state's top office holders, while the Party leads it.

party-commands-army.rationale: The Party programme states that the Party persists in its leadership over the People's Liberation Army.

party-controls-media.rationale: The history resolution calls the internet the main arena of ideological struggle and stresses the media's ability to guide opinion under Party leadership.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The Party constitution makes democratic centralism the fundamental organisational principle and requires members to execute Party decisions.

party-own-road.rationale: The programme says the Party develops relations with communist parties abroad on the principles of independence, complete equality, mutual respect and noninterference.

patriotic-education.rationale: The constitution has the state conduct education among the people in patriotism and collectivism.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The programme calls for developing the fine national traditional culture and the 20th report for its creative transformation and development.

private-courts-defense.rationale: The constitution makes courts organs of the state, created by the people's congresses.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: The programme bases foreign relations on non-interference, which is at odds with promoting a particular political system abroad.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: The constitution says the country is governed according to law and that all state organs, parties and organisations must abide by the Constitution and other laws.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The 20th report promises a policy system to boost birth rates and to bring down the costs of pregnancy, childbirth, child rearing and schooling.

property-franchise.rationale: The constitution gives the vote to all adult citizens regardless of property status.

property-fundamental.rationale: The constitution declares citizens' lawful private property inviolable yet allows expropriation for public use and keeps public ownership dominant, so the sources point both ways.

public-ownership.rationale: The Party programme and the 2018 state constitution make public ownership the dominant form within a mixed system, so major industries stay mainly publicly owned while private firms coexist.

racial-franchise.rationale: The constitution gives the vote to all adult citizens regardless of ethnicity or race.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: The constitution prohibits discrimination against and oppression of any ethnicity and calls for equality and mutual assistance.

recall-officials.rationale: The constitution gives electoral units the power to remove the delegates they elected, under procedures set by law.

recallable-delegates.rationale: The constitution lets electoral units remove their delegates in accordance with procedures prescribed by law, which is recall but not at any time.

region-keeps-system.rationale: The programme and the 20th report set out one country, two systems for Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, letting them keep their own system within one state.

regional-resource-ownership.rationale: The constitution vests natural resources in the state as the whole people, apart from some collectively owned land, not in the people of a region.

results-over-ideology.rationale: The programme names the benefit to productive forces as the criterion for judging all work, yet requires keeping to the Four Cardinal Principles and combating bourgeois liberalization, so its sources point both ways.

right-to-secede.rationale: The constitution makes all ethnic autonomous areas inseparable parts of the country and prohibits acts that undermine unity or instigate division.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The history resolution condemns the Cultural Revolution as a disaster and the programme calls for developing fine traditional culture.

separated-powers.rationale: The constitution assigns all state organs to the people's congresses, to which they are responsible, under democratic centralism rather than a division among co-equal checking bodies.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: The constitution gives women equal rights with men in all spheres, including family life.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: The constitution defines the state as led by the working class and says working people in state firms are the masters of the country.

socialism-one-country.rationale: The programme says that so long as Communists uphold the basic tenets and follow the road suited to China, the socialist cause in China will be crowned with final victory, without requiring revolutions elsewhere.

state-directs-investment.rationale: The 20th Congress report says to improve the layout of the state-owned sector and steer it toward strategic sectors, so the state is expected to direct capital to strategic industries.

state-harmful.rationale: The programme calls for consolidating the people's democratic dictatorship, so the state is something to build and strengthen, not abolish.

taxation-theft.rationale: The constitution makes paying taxes in accordance with law a duty of every citizen.

territorial-expansion.rationale: The 20th report says China will never seek hegemony or engage in expansionism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: The constitution gives citizens a right to material assistance when ill and tasks the state with developing social insurance and medical services; the 20th report reports basic medical insurance for 95 percent of the population.

vanguard-party.rationale: The Party constitution describes the Party as the vanguard of the working class and the core of leadership.

women-suffrage.rationale: The constitution gives every citizen aged 18 the vote regardless of sex and gives women equal rights with men in all spheres of life.

worker-farmer-alliance.rationale: The state constitution defines the state as led by the working class and based on the alliance of workers and peasants.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.rationale: The programme and constitution call for a patriotic united front of workers, farmers and intellectuals with all patriots, which has included private business owners.

workers-councils.rationale: The constitution makes the National People's Congress the basis of state power, so a parliament-type body is kept as the basis of political power.

workplace-democracy.rationale: The constitution requires state-owned enterprises to practise democratic management through congresses of workers and staff.

notes: Searched themes: economy and ownership, labour, government and party leadership, rights and duties, ethnicity and religion, Taiwan and foreign policy, ecology, culture, population and family. The CECC copy of the Party constitution is the 2002 text (see notFound for the current one); the 2022 report and 2021 resolution supply the later line. Where the documents say nothing that settles a statement it is null. Answers rest on the Party's and the state's own documents (words); no source on the regime's record in practice was opened, so answers where practice may diverge from words (religion, speech, media, courts) are left null or confined to what the documents state.
